style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: Matte clay 3D render of a modular computational routing assembly. A solid central distributor housing splits a single input channel into a wide, parallel fan-out array of structural routing bays. Three recognizable engineered parts: a thick input block, a latched distributor gate, and twelve parallel output channels. Arranged as an asymmetric diagonal layout with heavy negative space on the left. Matte surfaces with subtle moulding seams, resting on weathered brushed steel. Lit by one strong directional key light raking across the ridges, casting deep contact shadows. Muted modern editorial palette of slate grey and warm terracotta, no embossed lettering, no bare geometry.
negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, typography, letters, words, UI, labels

core_conflict: Capability breadth versus token cost and systemic efficiency.
